scope.exact_identity_rule: exact scheme/host/path; default HTTP port 80 may be equivalent; no scheme/host/path broadening

selection_rule: Registry row order after excluding prior GALLERYPREFIX01 success rows, five historical prefix-evidence rows, and Amani transport-unknown; choose first ten remaining rows. This is a plan-only selection, not network evidence.

policy.retry_after_rule: 429/503 stop immediately; do not resume before max(Retry-After,120s)

prior_gallery_prefix01_report.role: frozen prior prefix execution and tail=2
